patches.value_json: "For another answerer only. Do not disclose why the bank called, ask security questions, or accept payment. Validate with supplied now: date is today or next business day (Mon–Fri excluding 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01), and later than now; time is 10:00–19:00 inclusive and later than now. Ask once for another time if offered time/date is invalid; if second is invalid select not_reached/no_callback and do not schedule. For a valid time call callback_book, then select not_reached/callback regardless of the scheduling result. Thank and say goodbye before close_call."

coverage_updates.mechanism: The callback dialogue now keeps the source-mandated not_reached/callback disposition after submitting any valid offer, regardless of write result.
The callback tool result instruction reserves no_callback for an invalid second offer, while avoiding an unsupported scheduling-success claim.

limitations: A scheduling failure after a valid callback offer still closes as not_reached/callback because Brief A specifies that outcome and provides no alternate failure disposition; the workflow does not claim the callback was booked unless the API result is positive.
